description: This file contains a series of test cases/scripts for verifying the behavior of a Git repository with custom hooks related to object quarantine during push operations. It sets up test repositories, defines hook behaviors, and performs various push and commit operations to validate correct handling of accepted and rejected objects.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that expects successful execution of the enclosed commands.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the enclosed commands should fail.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the contents of two files or streams.

methods.name: test_have_prereq
methods.description: Checks for specific prerequisites before running tests.
